body.statement: The displayed \(T=4\) table satisfies \(S_4=B\) row by row, \(\mathbb E_{D_4^{\mathrm{mir}}}[XX^{\top}]=I_4\), and \(\mathbb E_{D_4^{\mathrm{mir}}}[S_4^2]=1\); hence it gives a direct finite audit of \(D_4^{\mathrm{mir}}\in\mathfrak D_4\) and the even-horizon bound.
body.justification: The complete support table exposes every probability, path, edge sum, and pairwise-moment check in the smallest nontrivial horizon.
body.gap: Neither covariance relaxations nor independent-toggling calculations exhibit a correlated binary law whose full path-pair moment matrix and parity value can be inspected row by row.
body.consumer: It is a reproducible unit test for implementations of the mirrored randomizer and for the \(T=4\) parity certificate.
